description: This file defines a helper logging utility class ('Log') that provides a static interface for logging messages at various levels, mirroring Android's native Log class. It manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log output and includes methods for different log levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error, assert).

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, managing a chain of LogNode objects for output.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the head of the LogNode linked list that receives log outputs.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode object that will receive log outputs.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log message to the current LogNode chain.
